overview.description: The UBS AG ETRACS Gold Shares Covered Call ETNs due February 2, 2033 (GLDI) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the Credit Suisse NASDAQ Gold FLOWS 103 index. The fund offers the returns of a covered call strategy comprised of shares of the ETF GLD, a physical gold ETF, and one-month call options with a strike price of 103% of GLD. GLDI was launched on Feb 2, 2013 and is issued by ETRACS.
